parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb) AS config
FROM config;

nodes.name: Screen applicants
nodes.notes: The whole ruleset. Thresholds live in the config table.

parameters.query:
-- Every applicant is stored, rejected ones included.
-- On a re-run only raw is updated: the stored status wins, so a human's
-- decision on a 'review' applicant is never overwritten.
INSERT INTO submissions
  (external_id, email, handle, platform, followers, status, reason, raw)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET raw = EXCLUDED.raw
RETURNING id, external_id, email, handle, platform, status,
          raw->>'tracking_code' AS tracking_code;

-- Insert the creator, or return the existing one, so a re-run still
-- reaches the email step instead of stopping here.
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO creators
    (submission_id, email, handle, platform, tracking_code, rate_cents_per_1k)
  SELECT s.id, s.email, s.handle, s.platform, $2,
         (SELECT value::int FROM config WHERE key = 'rate_cents_per_1k')
  FROM submissions s
  WHERE s.external_id = $1 AND s.status = 'accepted'
  ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, email, handle, tracking_code
)
SELECT id, email, handle, tracking_code FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT c.id, c.email, c.handle, c.tracking_code
FROM creators c
WHERE c.tracking_code = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins);

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $json.email, template: 'creator-welcome', handle: $json.handle, tracking_code: $json.tracking_code, idempotency_key: `welcome-${$json.tracking_code}` }) }}

nodes.name: Send welcome email
nodes.notes: After the creator row exists, so a re-run only retries the email.

parameters.query:
-- Same post seen twice = one row with fresh views, never a double payout.
INSERT INTO posts
  (creator_id, platform, external_id, url, published_at, views)
SELECT c.id, c.platform, $2, $3, $4::timestamptz, $5
FROM creators c
WHERE c.tracking_code = $1
ON CONFLICT (platform, external_id) DO UPDATE
  SET views = EXCLUDED.views, last_seen_at = now();

-- An invalid applicant is recorded once, however many polls see it again.
INSERT INTO dead_letters
  (workflow_id, workflow_name, execution_id, execution_url, node, kind,
   payload, attempts, error, reason)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, $10)
ON CONFLICT (kind, (COALESCE(payload->>'external_id', md5(payload::text))))
  WHERE reason = 'invalid' AND replayed_at IS NULL
  DO NOTHING;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$workflow.id, $workflow.name, $execution.id, `${$('Config').first().json.config.editor_base_url}/workflow/${$workflow.id}/executions/${$execution.id}`, $prevNode.name, ({ 'Fetch applications': 'poll', 'Valid?': 'screen', 'Send welcome email': 'onboard', 'Fetch posts': 'track' })[$prevNode.name] || 'unknown', JSON.stringify($json), $json.valid === false ? 1 : 4, ($json.reason ?? $json.error?.message ?? $json.error?.description ?? JSON.stringify($json.error ?? 'unknown failure')).slice(0, 500), $json.valid === false ? 'invalid' : 'exhausted'] }}

nodes.name: Dead letter
nodes.notes: 'invalid' = the data is wrong, fix it at the source. 'exhausted' = retried 4 times, run the pipeline again once the provider is back.
